```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

ps <- read_csv(
  "PSCompPars_2026.07.29_10.50.24.csv",
  skip = 328,
  col_types = cols(
    sy_icmagerr2 = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Verify the structure and data types for the parsed table.
glimpse(ps)

# Check for missing values across all columns.
ps %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)), .names = "{col}")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing") %>%
  filter(missing > 0)
```

```{r}
# 1. Read the HWC table and extract the 70 planet names
phl_70_planets <- read_csv("hwc_table_all.csv") %>% 
  pull(Name)

# 2. Verify we fetched all 70 planets
length(phl_70_planets)
head(phl_70_planets)

cat(phl_70_planets, sep = "\n")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)

system_data <- ps %>%
  mutate(
    is_phl = as.integer(pl_name %in% phl_70_planets),
    st_lum = (st_rad / 1)^2 * (st_teff / 5772)^4,
    hz_in = 0.95 * sqrt(st_lum),
    hz_out = 1.37 * sqrt(st_lum)
  ) %>%
  group_by(hostname) %>%
  summarise(
    phl_any = as.integer(sum(is_phl, na.rm = TRUE) > 0),
    st_mass = mean(st_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    st_rad = mean(st_rad, na.rm = TRUE),
    st_teff = mean(st_teff, na.rm = TRUE),
    st_met = mean(st_met, na.rm = TRUE),
    sy_kmag = mean(sy_kmag, na.rm = TRUE),
    st_lum = mean(st_lum, na.rm = TRUE),
    hz_in = mean(hz_in, na.rm = TRUE),
    hz_out = mean(hz_out, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(st_mass, st_rad, st_teff, st_met, sy_kmag, st_lum, hz_in, hz_out)

write_rds(system_data, "system_data.rds")

print(table(system_data$phl_any))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)

system_data <- read_rds("system_data.rds")

model <- glm(
  phl_any ~ st_mass + st_teff + st_met + sy_kmag + st_lum + hz_in + hz_out,
  data = system_data,
  family = binomial()
)

summary(model)

or_ci <- exp(cbind(OR = coef(model), confint(model)))
print(or_ci)

pred <- predict(model, type = "link", se.fit = TRUE)

system_data <- system_data %>%
  mutate(
    pred_link = pred$fit,
    pred_link_se = pred$se.fit,
    predicted_prob = plogis(pred_link),
    prob_lo = plogis(pred_link - 1.96 * pred_link_se),
    prob_hi = plogis(pred_link + 1.96 * pred_link_se)
  )

baseline_prob <- mean(system_data$phl_any)
threshold <- max(0.03, baseline_prob)

system_data <- system_data %>%
  mutate(
    pred_class = as.integer(predicted_prob > threshold),
    correct = pred_class == phl_any
  )

cat("Baseline probability of phl_any == 1:", round(baseline_prob, 4), "\n")
cat("Classification threshold used:", threshold, "\n")

roc_obj <- roc(system_data$phl_any, system_data$predicted_prob)
plot(roc_obj, main = "ROC Curve for PHL Logistic Model")
cat("AUC:", auc(roc_obj), "\n")

accuracy <- mean(system_data$correct)
cat("Prediction accuracy:", round(accuracy, 3), "\n")

conf_mat <- table(Predicted = system_data$pred_class, Actual = system_data$phl_any)
print(conf_mat)

TP <- conf_mat["1", "1"]
TN <- conf_mat["0", "0"]
FP <- conf_mat["1", "0"]
FN <- conf_mat["0", "1"]

sensitivity <- TP / (TP + FN)
specificity <- TN / (TN + FP)
precision <- TP / (TP + FP)

cat("Sensitivity (Recall):", round(sensitivity, 3), "\n")
cat("Specificity:", round(specificity, 3), "\n")
cat("Precision:", round(precision, 3), "\n")

conf_df <- tibble(
  class = c("True Positive", "False Positive", "True Negative", "False Negative"),
  count = c(TP, FP, TN, FN)
)

# Plot predicted probabilities with 95% CI error bars
print(
  ggplot(system_data, aes(x = predicted_prob, y = factor(phl_any), color = correct)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = prob_lo, xmax = prob_hi), height = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_y_discrete(name = "Actual PHL Class", labels = c("0", "1")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "red", "TRUE" = "blue")) +
    labs(
      x = "Predicted probability of PHL system",
      color = "Prediction correct",
      title = "Predicted probabilities with 95% CI"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
)

accuracy_summary <- system_data %>%
  count(correct) %>%
  mutate(correct = if_else(correct, "Correct", "Incorrect"))

print(
  ggplot(accuracy_summary, aes(x = correct, y = n, fill = correct)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of systems",
      title = paste0("Prediction accuracy: ", round(accuracy, 3))
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
)

print(
  ggplot(conf_df, aes(x = class, y = count, fill = class)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of systems",
      title = "Model Confusion Matrix Performance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
)

plot_data <- system_data %>%
  select(st_mass, st_rad, st_teff, st_met, sy_kmag, st_lum, hz_in, hz_out, predicted_prob, phl_any) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(predicted_prob, phl_any),
    names_to = "predictor",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    predictor = recode(
      predictor,
      st_mass = "Stellar mass",
      st_rad = "Stellar radius",
      st_teff = "Stellar temperature",
      st_met = "Metallicity",
      sy_kmag = "K-band magnitude",
      st_lum = "Luminosity",
      hz_in = "HZ inner boundary",
      hz_out = "HZ outer boundary"
    )
  )

print(
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = value, y = predicted_prob, color = factor(phl_any))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~ predictor, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "grey40", "1" = "royalblue"), name = "Actual phl_any") +
    labs(
      x = "Predictor value",
      y = "Predicted probability of phl_any == 1",
      title = "Predictors vs. modeled probability of a habitable planet system"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
)
```
